comparison.objective: Tune a damper versus route two robot-axis cables and latch a cable carrier.
comparison.physical_skill: Hex-key/collar adjustment and repeated cycling versus bimanual cable routing, ordering, and twelve snap-latch closures.
comparison.success_condition: Repeatable impact absorption with lock retention versus every carrier link covered and latched, cables uncrossed, and strain relief not displaced over 5 mm.
comparison.reason: The record tests deformable routing and repeated latching, not dynamic commissioning. Candidate rebound, overload, and drift thresholds remain unspecified.
